zh_points: 特朗普周六在田纳西集会上提议把大西洋或太平洋改名，如“特朗普洋”；报道称他去年已把墨西哥湾改名“美国湾”，8 月又改了安大略湖。
en_points: At a Tennessee rally Saturday, Trump floated renaming the Atlantic or Pacific, e.g. 'Trump Ocean'; he previously renamed the Gulf of Mexico and, in August, Lake Ontario.

title: Staying Warm Into Monday Before a Big Pattern Change
zh_title: 暖意持续到周一，之后大幅转凉
zh_points: 今天晴，微南风，最高约 80°F（约 27°C），夜间低温 60 多°F；周一仍似夏天，后半周转凉并有降雨。记得备好外套和伞。
en_points: Sunny today with highs near 80 and a light southerly breeze; mild night in the low 60s. Summer-like Monday, then cooler with rain chances later in the week.
action: 下半周备好外套和雨伞

title: Firefighter’s toddler son dies after he and his father hit by car while window-shopping
zh_title: 佐治亚消防员幼子停车场被撞身亡
zh_points: 佐治亚州 Gainesville 一辆 SUV 停车时意外加速冲上路缘，撞倒正在逛街的消防员父子，22 个月大的男孩不幸身亡；外州新闻。
en_points: In Gainesville, Georgia, an SUV accidentally accelerated over a curb while parking and hit a firefighter and his 22-month-old son; the boy died. Out-of-state news.

title: 1,500 pumpkins gone by 11 a.m. at Oak Bank’s annual giveaway in Fitchburg
zh_title: Oak Bank 送南瓜，1500 个提前送光
zh_points: Fitchburg 的 Oak Bank 周六办第 25 届南瓜赠送，原定到中午，1500 个南瓜上午 11 点就领完；活动已结束。
en_points: Oak Bank's 25th annual Great Pumpkin Give Away in Fitchburg was set to run until noon Saturday, but all 1,500 pumpkins were gone by 11 a.m. The event is over.

title: Agents tear-gas protesters after group blocks ICE vehicles
zh_title: 俄勒冈示威者围堵 ICE 车辆遭催泪瓦斯
zh_points: 俄勒冈州 Salem 约 30 人周六上午围堵配合 ICE 执法的联邦探员车辆，探员动用催泪瓦斯驱散；国际生应远离此类冲突现场。
en_points: In Salem, Oregon, about 30 people blocked in federal agents working with ICE on Saturday, and agents used tear gas. International students should steer clear of such scenes.

title: Maurer’s Urban Market opens in Madison after neighborhood pushes for grocery access
zh_title: 麦迪逊南区新开独立超市 Maurer's
zh_points: Maurer's Urban Market 周六在麦迪逊南区开业，女性经营的独立超市，卖新鲜蔬果、熟食、咖啡和本地产品；住南边的同学多了买菜选择。
en_points: Maurer's Urban Market, an independent woman-owned grocery with produce, prepared meals and coffee, opened Saturday on Madison's South Side.

title: DeForest toddler reaches ‘Baby of the Year’ quarterfinals as family shares IVF story
zh_title: DeForest 幼儿进入“年度宝宝”赛四分之一决赛
zh_points: 15 个月大的 Millie 从 57 名宝宝的分组中突围，进入全国“年度宝宝”评选四分之一决赛，家人借此分享试管婴儿经历；本地温情新闻。
en_points: Fifteen-month-old Millie Strommen of DeForest advanced from a group of 57 to the quarterfinals of a national Baby of the Year contest; her family shares their IVF story.

title: Tornadoes spotted across multiple counties as severe weather from Isaias remains
zh_title: Isaias 残余引发佐治亚、南卡多地龙卷风
zh_points: 飓风 Isaias 衍生的强风暴周六在佐治亚与南卡交界一带至少 3 个县造成龙卷风破坏，Aiken、Saluda 两县曾发龙卷风警报；外州新闻。
en_points: Tornadoes spun off from Hurricane Isaias damaged at least three counties in the Georgia–South Carolina CSRA region Saturday, with warnings for Aiken and Saluda counties.

title: State trooper Bradley Ritger honored at funeral in Chippewa Falls
zh_title: 殉职州警 Bradley Ritger 葬礼举行
zh_points: 家人、同事和全美执法人员周六在 Chippewa Falls 送别州警 Ritger；他 9 月处理追车时受伤，10/2 殉职，曾在州巡警服务 5 年。
en_points: Family, friends and officers from across the country honored Trooper Bradley Ritger at his funeral Saturday in Chippewa Falls; he died Oct. 2 after a September pursuit injury.

title: Wisconsin men’s basketball opens exhibition season with 94-71 win over UW-Parkside
zh_title: 男篮热身赛 94–71 胜 UW-Parkside
zh_points: 威州男篮周六在 Kohl Center 首场表演赛 94–71 击败 UW-Parkside，Nolan Winter 9 投 7 中得 15 分；球迷首次看到新阵容。
en_points: Wisconsin men's basketball beat UW-Parkside 94-71 in its exhibition opener at the Kohl Center; Nolan Winter scored 15 on 7-of-9 shooting. First look at the new roster.

title: Sailboat capsizes on Lake Mendota near Marshall Park
zh_title: Mendota 湖帆船遇阵风翻船，全员无碍
zh_points: 周六下午 4:15 左右，一艘帆船在 Marshall Park 附近被突来阵风吹翻，附近船只上前协助，所有人都穿着救生衣；在湖上活动务必穿救生衣。
en_points: A sudden gust capsized a sailboat on Lake Mendota near Marshall Park around 4:15 p.m. Saturday; nearby boats helped and everyone wore life jackets. Always wear one on the lake.

title: Portage man charged with 10 counts of possession of child sexual abuse material
zh_title: Portage 男子被控 10 项持有儿童色情罪
zh_points: 8/15 国家失踪与受虐儿童中心向警方举报后，Portage 一名 30 岁男子被查出在两个社媒平台分享违法内容，现被控 10 项罪名；外地治安新闻。
en_points: After an Aug. 15 tip from NCMEC, Portage police say a 30-year-old man shared child sexual abuse material on two social media platforms; he faces 10 possession counts.

title: What to do if you encounter wild animals after a major storm
zh_title: 佛州提醒：风暴后遇野生动物保持距离
zh_points: 佛州鱼类与野生动物保护委员会提醒，风暴后洪水区可能出现更多鳄鱼和蛇，应保持距离；暴风天气还可能让海牛、小海龟搁浅。外州新闻。
en_points: Florida's FWC advises giving wildlife space after a major storm: alligators and snakes may be more visible in flooded areas, and manatees or turtle hatchlings may be stranded.

title: This warm stretch isn’t budging for a few days
zh_title: 暖意几天不退，周一晚起转雷雨
zh_points: 周末威州南部晴，最高 70 多到近 80°F（约 25–27°C），像八月下旬；周一暖意转为晚间雷雨，下周多轮阵雨。
en_points: Highs in the upper 70s to near 80 with sunshine this weekend, feeling like late August; Monday's warmth gives way to evening storms and rounds of showers next week.
